as_told.title: Tom DeLonge, To The Stars Academy and Lockheed Martin

plain: Around 2015, a man named Tom DeLonge is said to have made contact with someone who worked at Skunk Works, the secret advanced aircraft division of the defence company Lockheed Martin. A researcher named Jason Simosa says the researcher Jacques Vallée has confirmed this "original story". A guest named Jay Anderson tells it in more detail: DeLonge's contact invited him to introduce the bosses on stage at a family-and-friends event, and DeLonge said he wanted "10 minutes with your boss afterwards". Michels mentions it briefly as DeLonge meeting Lockheed executives. It matters to the tellers because it would mean a private citizen got a hearing from inside one of the most secret parts of American aerospace.
